lyrics:
[Intro: finger snaps, lazy guitar lick, low hum]

[Verse 1: talk-sung male voice, half a grin]
Met her at a red light in nineteen ninety-eight
Hair out the window, Oklahoma plate
Been riding shotgun in that laugh ever since
Thirty years of mornings and I ain't bored yet

[Chorus: sung, smooth harmonies, slow groove]
She's got laugh lines and county lines
And I know every one by heart
That crease right there's the year the twins were born
That one's from dancing in the dark
I take it slow, I know the way
I could travel it with my eyes closed, blind
Laugh lines and county lines

[Verse 2: talk-sung, snaps and bass]
Them magazine girls ain't been anywhere yet
No map on their faces, no stories, no debt
Mine's got a road for every joke I ever told
And one or two for the ones that got old

[Chorus: sung, smooth harmonies, slow groove]
She's got laugh lines and county lines
And I know every one by heart
That crease right there's the year the twins were born
That one's from dancing in the dark
I take it slow, I know the way
I could travel it with my eyes closed, blind
Laugh lines and county lines

[Bridge: snaps only, spoken low]
She says, "Quit staring." I say, "I'm reading."
She says, "What's it say?"
I say, "Keep going. Speed limit: easy."

[Final Chorus: full groove, harmonies stacked]
She's got laugh lines and county lines
And I know every one by heart
That crease right there's the year the twins were born
That one's from dancing in the dark
I take it slow, I know the way
I could travel it with my eyes closed, blind
Laugh lines and county lines

[Outro: snaps, a woman's laugh, guitar lick]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 99 BPM with a half-time sway, 4/4, F major. Lazy, warm and unhurried.

VOICE: Male, low-to-mid range with a soft drawl. Verses are spoken in rhythm with a smile; choruses are sung smoothly with close harmonies behind. The bridge is a murmured conversation. A woman laughs at the end.

INSTRUMENTS: Finger snaps on two and four, a clean electric guitar playing a short lazy lick, a deep round bass, a soft kick, an acoustic guitar strum, a little electric piano, backing voices humming.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, snaps and lick. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:34 Chorus 1. 1:03 Verse 2. 1:27 Chorus 2. 1:56 Bridge, snaps only. 2:14 Final chorus. 2:44 Outro, snaps and a laugh, ends 2:58.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2017 country with an R&B pocket: sparse, dry, deep bass, the voice close enough to hear him smile.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'I'm reading' in the bridge at 2:00.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original admires a young woman's shape. This one admires what thirty years wrote on a face, and says plainly that the magazines have it backwards.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Fond, admiring, teasing, settled.
